full_judgment: 2. The short facts for disposal of the Rule are that the defendants-opposite parties obtained an ex-parte decree on 10.2.1977 in S.C.C. Suit No.5 of 1972 instituted against one Jiban Kishore Ghose, the father of the petitioners, for eviction from certain premises. It was alleged that the Jiban Kishore was not aware of the said decree as the same was obtained fraudulently by suppressing: the process and subsequently came to know about the same while the opposite parties were trying to take delivery of possession of the disputed premises. Thereafter he instituted Title Suit No.562 of 1977 in the Munsif, 3rd Court of Com ilia for setting aside the ex-parte decree. The opposite-parties herein contested the said suit by filing written statement denying' the allegation that process were suppressed fraudulently.
